title: Premium Travel Route Reel — Scotland / The Open Road
description: 30-second R5 director's cut: Highland road cold open, four two-shot destinations, restrained road-matched cartography and save-the-route finale. Original procedural score, editable photos and route.
author: OpenMotion Studio

stops.name: Edinburgh
stops.note: Begin beneath Edinburgh Castle, where the Old Town rises above the city.

stops.name: Glen Coe
stops.note: Drive past dramatic mountain walls and a glacial Highland valley.

stops.name: Eilean Donan
stops.note: A celebrated island castle stands where three sea lochs meet.

stops.name: Portree
stops.note: Finish in Skye's colourful harbour town, surrounded by island scenery.
